theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (w : Euclid n → ℤ) (Gh : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (N + 1)) (Ah : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (wh : Euclid (n + 1) → ℤ), LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → Measurable w → IntegrableOn (fun u => (w u : ℝ)) A → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G u) → (∀ z, Gh z = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons (WithLp.ofLp z 0) (WithLp.ofLp (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z))))))) → Ah = {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} → (∀ z, wh z = w (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)))) → LipschitzWith (max 1 L) Gh ∧ MeasurableSet Ah ∧ Measurable wh ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => (wh z : ℝ)) Ah ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (n + 1)) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) n), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin n → Euclid N), η x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∫ u in A, (w u : ℝ) * η (G u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = ∫ z in Ah, (wh z : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1)) (Gh z) (fun a => fderiv ℝ Gh z (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
